verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an official Python Connector SDK for building and deploying custom connectors, with a setup guide and GitHub repo. It also ships AI coding-agent plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI, plus a Cursor tutorial, which suits AI-native users. A documented REST API supports programmatic account management. Missing for 10: official client SDKs for the management REST API, language coverage beyond Python, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK.
